name: Sticky Scroll Reveal
description: Sticky viewport canvas where descriptive text blocks scroll past while the associated visual/illustration card smoothly transitions and updates in place.
visual_characteristics: Clean 50/50 split layout, fixed visual card with rounded corners, smooth gradient background transitions.
interaction_behavior: Natural document scroll triggers card transitions based on active content index in viewport.
unsuitable_use_cases: Fast scanning mobile views without height
performance_considerations: Optimized composite opacity and transform transitions; lightweight DOM footprint.
accessibility_considerations: Screen readers read semantic content order naturally; respects prefers-reduced-motion.
mobile_behavior: Unpins into a natural sequential single-column feed with image above text.

name: 3D Card Effect
description: Interactive card that responds to mouse cursor position with 3D perspective rotation, translating internal elements along the Z-axis for physical depth.
visual_characteristics: Smooth perspective tilt, multi-layer depth, subtle border highlight.
interaction_behavior: Tracks pointer mousemove inside card bounds; returns smoothly to rest position on mouseleave.
unsuitable_use_cases: Mobile touch cards with no cursor hover
performance_considerations: Uses CSS translate3d and transform without re-rendering layout.
accessibility_considerations: Card remains fully keyboard focusable; tilt effect is decorative and inert for screen readers.
mobile_behavior: Renders as static clean card with zero touch overhead.

name: Marquee
description: Smooth, infinitely scrolling horizontal marquee for logos, testimonials, or tickers with pause-on-hover capability and edge gradient masks.
visual_characteristics: Seamless horizontal loop, customizable speed, elegant fade-out masks on left and right edges.
interaction_behavior: Continuous auto-scroll; pauses when user hovers or focuses with keyboard.
unsuitable_use_cases: Critical text that must be read immediately
technology: React, Tailwind CSS, pure CSS animation
performance_considerations: Driven by pure CSS `transform: translateX()`; zero JavaScript execution cost during scroll.
accessibility_considerations: Supports WCAG 2.2.2 pause-on-hover/focus; pauses completely under prefers-reduced-motion.

name: Blur Text
description: Staggered text entrance where individual words or characters animate from a soft blur into crisp focus with subtle vertical translation.
visual_characteristics: Sophisticated typographic entrance, smooth optical de-blurring.
interaction_behavior: Triggers on section entrance or scroll viewport entry.
performance_considerations: Blur filter cost is localized to text entrance and cleans up immediately upon landing.
accessibility_considerations: Text content remains semantically intact in DOM for screen readers and search crawlers.
mobile_behavior: Faster duration or instant text under prefers-reduced-motion.

name: Accessible Dialog Modal
description: Production-grade accessible modal dialog built on Radix UI primitives with focus trapping, escape-key dismissal, background lock, and smooth fade/scale transitions.
visual_characteristics: Subtle backdrop overlay, centered card with clean border and accessible close button.
interaction_behavior: Trap focus inside dialog; restore focus to triggering element upon dismissal.
technology: React, Radix UI Primitives, Tailwind CSS
performance_considerations: Unmounts from DOM when closed; portal-rendered outside root overflow.
accessibility_considerations: Full WAI-ARIA Dialog modal conformance, auto-focuses first input, locks body scroll.
mobile_behavior: Full-width adaptive dialog or bottom drawer conversion.
